roi_segmenter.onnx.name: mask_logits
roi_segmenter.onnx.postprocess: sigmoid >= 0.45, bounding rectangle + 4% horizontal and 8% vertical margins

cccd_preprocessing: This web package preserves RGB for all predictions and does not apply grayscale conversion. Training used grayscale for CCCD, so inference preprocessing intentionally differs for this speed/input test.
browser_pipeline: EXIF-oriented source image letterboxed on white to 256x256 while retaining RGB
normalize RGB channels with ImageNet mean/std
run roi_segmenter.onnx and return mask_logits with shape [1,1,256,256]
apply sigmoid threshold 0.45; map predicted ROI rectangle to original source coordinates with margins
crop original RGB image and letterbox to 224x224
run roi_classifier.onnx and return class_logits with shape [1,9]; softmax for class probabilities
no grayscale transformation is applied in browser inference
notes: Static inference handoff. The training run was stopped at epoch 28; best checkpoint from epoch 27 is packaged. Test split was not run for this checkpoint.
